answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 30852 Country: India Title: My friend has put her daughter name " " RIDA " Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings.and tell me about "AL-RIDA'' .Can i put this name AL RIDA for the girl. Question: Question: My friend has put her daughter name " " RIDA " Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings.and tell me about "AL-RIDA'' .Can i put this name AL RIDA for the girl. Answer ID: 30852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 334/302/B=1432) It is correct to keep the name Rida (ردا). It means chuddar. You can continue with it, you need not to change it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
